title: Lost Mary BM6000 Mr Blue Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Mr Blue is a complex and highly popular profile that combines a rich berry medley with a sharp, cooling finish. The blend features a juicy mix of blueberries, blackberries, and raspberries, creating a sweet and slightly tart foundation. A brisk, icy menthol breeze wraps up the exhale, leaving the palate feeling thoroughly refreshed after every draw. Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM6000 V2 Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack utilises a unique refilling system to deliver extended performance. The pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a separate 10ml e-liquid refill container. This combination allows you to automatically refill the pod while it is attached to the device, offering up to 6000 puffs per pack and the flexibility to swap flavours whenever you choose. How To Setup Lost Mary BM6000 Pod & Refill Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set! When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your Lost Mary BM6000 V2 device. Discover every flavour with our Lost Mary BM6000 refill collection .
